LanguageData.Gun_Desert_Eagle_50AE_RWP.label: Desert Eagle .50AE
LanguageData.Gun_Desert_Eagle_50AE_RWP.description: The Desert Eagle .50AE is a semi-automatic pistol known for its impressive power and distinctive design. Chambered in .50 Action Express, it delivers high damage output with each shot. Though it has a slower firing rate and limited range compared to rifles, its sheer stopping power makes it a formidable choice for close to mid-range combat. Its large size and weight can make it cumbersome, but few sidearms can match its impact.
